title: 第17章 昙花血蒺藜雪夜杀机来第18章 神弩加特林vs鬼神修士
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
唐宇想杀李浪，他等不及了！
爹哪里懂得，他唐宇在雕工铺外院的处境？
那种遭受人人白眼、嫌恶、喊打的感觉，让习惯被阿谀奉承的唐宇根本无法忍受！
因为，这一切明明本来就是他的！
身为唐氏雕工铺主家的子弟，其他的子弟又不是没有这样做过，凭什么只有他唐宇要受这份屈辱与委屈！
种种情绪涌上心头，似烟花般轰然爆裂！
“我要他死！”
唐宇内心在咆哮！
不过，片刻而已，他凶戾扭曲的面容，慢慢归于平静：“如今，这李浪成为了正式雕师，等他搬入到唐氏庇护府邸，那就动不得他了。”
“到时候要对付他，就得老老实实按照爹的办法……我等不及！”
“叶金宝如今受到天工坊紧急召唤，暂时没时间给李浪解决搬入庇护府邸的事情，但是，名单已经上报，我虽然让爹帮忙压下，但不知道能拖几天。”
“李浪一旦搬入唐氏庇护府邸之内，到时候，有武夫守卫巡逻，想动手，难如登天！”
唐宇坐在了唐老三坐过的椅子上，倒了杯热茶。
眯起眼。
盯着慢慢在杯盏中沉落的碧绿茶叶。
“所以……我得尽快动手！”
“另外……”
唐宇唇角扬起，他也打听到，李浪的妹妹李照清被圣童教盯上的事情。
这也是唐宇动了杀李浪想法的原因之一。
杀了李浪，直接将罪名推到圣童教头上便可！

至于杀人？
对于唐宇这等子弟而言，根本不算什么。
一口饮尽杯中茶水，肥嘟嘟的五指一攥，一柄锋锐亮丽的长刀竟是凭空出现在他的手中。
这唐宇，竟然也拥有鬼神空饰，足以表明唐老三对他可当真是喜爱的紧。
“噗——！”
口中饮下的茶水喷在锵亮长刀刀身之上！
颗粒分明的水珠，顺着冰冷刀锋，慢慢滚落，好似映照出唐宇满口森然的白牙。
“李浪，你死定了！”
……
……
李浪回到了内院，到叶大师的工坊中，寻到了倪嫣和清清。
倪嫣正在教导清清如何雕刻木雕，红色面纱下的长睫毛眼睛，闪烁着明亮的辉光。
“哥！”
清清远远就看到李浪，顿时开心的蹦起来。
倪嫣亦是起身，看到了李浪，便是说道：“浪师弟，你来的正好，师姐跟你商量个事。”
李浪揉了揉奔到身边，抱住他大腿的清清脑袋，点了点头。
“倪师妹，你说。”
倪嫣柳叶眉顿时一蹙，双手叉在纤腰上：“喊师姐！”
李浪无奈，道了声师姐。
“你尚未搬到唐氏庇护府邸内，清清又被圣童教盯上……让清清晚上跟我一起住，别跟你回了。”

“我这段时间都住在唐氏庇护府邸内，安全有保障。”
“以你的实力，若是圣童教那野猪护法出手，怕是挡不住呐。”
倪嫣眼睛中浮现一抹担忧之色，说道。
至于让李浪留宿，那自然不可能。
content_en:
Tang Yu wants to kill Li Lang, he can't wait any longer!
How could dad understand Tang Yu's situation in the outer courtyard of Diao Gong Pu?
The feeling of being looked down upon, disgusted, and beaten by everyone was simply unbearable for Tang Yu, who was used to being flattered!
Because, all of this obviously belongs to him!
As a descendant of the owner of Tang's carving shop, it's not like other disciples have done this before, so why should Tang Yu be the only one to suffer this humiliation and grievance!
All kinds of emotions surged into my heart, exploding like fireworks!
"I want him dead!"
Tang Yu was roaring in his heart!
However, after a moment, his fierce and twisted face slowly returned to calm: "Now, this Li Lang has become an official sculptor. When he moves into the Tang family's asylum residence, he will not be touched."
"If we want to deal with him then, we have to follow dad's methods honestly... I can't wait!"
"Ye Jinbao has been urgently summoned by Tiangongfang and has no time to help Li Lang resolve the matter of moving into the asylum mansion. However, the list has been submitted. Although I asked dad to help suppress it, I don't know how many days it can be delayed."
"Once Li Lang moves into the Tang family's sheltered residence, there will be warrior guards patrolling him. It will be difficult to do anything!"
Tang Yu sat on the chair where Tang Laosan had sat and poured a cup of hot tea.
Narrow your eyes.
Staring at the green tea leaves slowly sinking in the cup.
"So...I have to do it as soon as possible!"
"In addition..."
The corners of Tang Yu's lips raised. He also found out that Li Lang's sister Li Zhaoqing was being targeted by the Holy Child Cult.
This was one of the reasons why Tang Yu had the idea of ​​killing Li Lang.
Just kill Li Lang and blame the Saint Child directly!
As for killing?
For youngsters like Tang Yu, it's nothing.
After drinking the tea in the cup in one gulp, he clenched his plump fingers, and a sharp and bright long knife appeared out of thin air in his hand.
This Tang Yu actually has a ghost and god costume, which is enough to show that Tang Laosan really loves him.
"Pfft——!"
The tea he drank in his mouth sprayed on the blade of the long and bright sword!
The clear-grained water drops slowly rolled down along the cold blade, seeming to reflect Tang Yu's white teeth.
"Li Lang, you are dead!"
…
…
Li Lang returned to the inner courtyard and found Ni Yan and Qing Qing in Master Ye's workshop.
Ni Yan is teaching Qingqing how to carve wood carvings, and her long-lashed eyes under the red veil are shining brightly.
"Brother!"
Qingqing saw Li Lang from a distance and immediately jumped up with joy.
Ni Yan also stood up, saw Li Lang, and said, "Junior brother Lang, you came just in time. Senior sister wants to discuss something with you."
Li Lang rubbed Qing Qing's head, who ran to his side, hugged his thigh, and nodded.
"Junior sister Ni, tell me."
Ni Yan's eyebrows suddenly furrowed and she put her hands on her waist: "Call Senior Sister!"
Li Lang had no choice but to call his senior sister.
"You haven't moved to the Tang family's asylum residence yet, and Qingqing is being targeted by the Holy Child Cult again... Let Qingqing stay with me at night, and don't come back with you."
"I have been living in the Tang Family Asylum Mansion during this period, and I am safe and secure."
"With your strength, if the Holy Child Cult's wild boar guardian takes action, I'm afraid you won't be able to stop it."
Ni Yan said with a worried look in her eyes.
As for letting Li Lang stay overnight, that was naturally impossible.
